rules: Audacity remains P1/SHOULD interactive editor provider.
Audacity OpenVINO remains P2/OPTIONAL and a strong pattern source.
CPU-only AI execution requires no accelerator discovery or lease.
Accelerator execution requires HRB lease and FA3-ACCEL-GUARD-001 reconciliation.
Resource envelopes are workload-derived; fixed CPU/GPU/NPU/NUMA placement constants are forbidden.
No implicit display-to-compute or accelerator fallback.
Provider admission failure is fail-closed and SHALL NOT degrade base Audacity.
